title: Regular anti-phase templates in the stable marriage problem: a generator criterion, its converse, and a counting bound
summary: We study a family of highly symmetric instances of the stable marriage problem built from regular actions of finite groups. Given a finite group G of order n and an ordering A of its elements, we define the regular anti-phase template P(G,A). These templates have n canonical stable matchings. We show that the anti-phase condition is canonical: among automorphism-maximal profiles, the anti-phase templates are exactly those satisfying a constant rank-sum identity.
